scope: Theorem 7.2 (Global generators and full-group lifts) of the manuscript “Infinitely many closed geodesic images on every Riemannian sphere” (preprints/Infinitely-many-closed-geodesic-images-on-every-Riemannian-sphere-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 345 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 123ee5276415debb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 31-32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For n ≥ 3, there are classes Xm ∈ Bam ∞ = Ham R (Λ, M), m ≥ 1, with the following properties. (i) The classes ξm,k = wk Xm, ηm,k = e wk Xm, m ≥ 1, 0 ≤ k ≤ d, form a graded F2-basis of B∞. Their degrees are |ξm,k| = am + k, |ηm,k| = am + n + k. We call the ξm,k the bottoms and the ηm,k the tops at stage m. Multiplication by wn annihilates B∞. (ii) Every Xm is the restriction of a class ζm ∈ Ham G (Λ, M). If m is odd, then Unζm = 0. If m is even, there is also a class Ym ∈ Ham+n G (Λ, M) with resR Ym = eXm. 31 (iii) For the round metric, let Zp be an open regular sublevel containing exactly the first p positive critical manifolds, and choose Z0 below the first one. For H = R, G, every crossing sequence for (Zp, Zm0−1), p ≥ m0, is short exact. A chosen class of the m-th crossing has a unique extension to Hj H(Λ, Zm−1) whenever j < am+1, for H = R, G. The lifts in (ii) and the classes Xm can be obtained from these relative extensions.
